cases.description: A warm jacket for a cold trek, with a budget written as "8k" and a size.

turns.user: I'm going trekking in Ladakh in December, need a jacket under 8k, size L.
turns.reply:
Ladakh in December is extremely cold, so I'll infer extreme warmth.
The UrbanLayer Pamir is very light, waterproof and well reviewed, and the TrekNorth Summit is heavier and warmer for long cold days. Some of these are cut for women or are unisex, so check the gender on each card.

cases.description: Shoe type, a waterproof attribute and a UK size.

turns.reply: UrbanStep Glide and TrailKing Terra (unisex) are well-rated picks that cost less, and the PaceOne Breeze is the top-rated women's pair. Gender varies between these, so check each card before you pick.

cases.description: A boolean attribute with a "15k" budget.

turns.user: A 5G phone under 15k with a good battery
turns.reply: The Pixelon Nova has a big battery and the best rating of these. If you want the largest battery, look at the Novaphone Nova or Aurora Zen, but their ratings are lower.

cases.description: A boolean attribute with a numeric minimum.

turns.user: A waterproof trekking backpack, at least 40 litres
turns.reply: The Commuto 54 L and TrailCarry 42 L have the highest ratings and cost less than most of the others. If you need room for a multi-day trek, look at the 65 to 70 L UrbanSling packs, though they're rated lower.

cases.description: Three attributes, one of which (gender) also accepts unisex.

turns.user: An analog watch with a leather strap for men
turns.reply: The Kaal Luxe is the best value for its rating, and the Kaal Pulse is the premium pick with lots of reviews. The Horizon Active is the cheapest but has a lower rating.

cases.description: An appliance type with a budget.

turns.reply: The Annapurna Eco has the highest rating, plus a 3-year warranty. The Swaad Turbo has the largest basket and the longest warranty, which makes it a good pick for bigger families.

cases.description: Adding an attribute keeps the earlier budget and size.

turns.user: I'm going trekking in Ladakh in December, need a jacket under 8k, size L.
turns.reply:
Ladakh in December is extremely cold, so I'll start with high-warmth filters as an inferred constraint.
I only included extreme-warmth down jackets, since Ladakh gets far below freezing in December. The UrbanLayer Pamir is very light and waterproof, so it's good for trekking, and the TrekNorth Summit is a well-reviewed waterproof choice. Some of these are cut for women or are unisex, so check the gender on each card.
All four are men's down jackets. The UrbanLayer Pamir is the lightest and best-rated, while the TrekNorth Summit is heavier but has lots of reviews.

cases.description: Narrowing to one brand keeps the type and budget.

turns.reply: PaceOne Terra has the top rating and every size from UK 6 to UK 11. If you'll be trekking in the monsoon, UrbanStep Glide is the best-rated waterproof pair here.
TrailKing Apex at ₹2,569 is the top-rated value pick, but it isn't waterproof. TrailKing Metro at ₹5,209 is the best-rated waterproof option and comes in the widest range of sizes.

cases.description: "The second one" resolves against the shown list. The second-cheapest backpack is an UrbanSling.

turns.reply: The UrbanSling Ridge is the only one of these three that's waterproof and has a laptop compartment. The Commuto Ridge has the best rating and the most space.

turns.user: Tell me more about the second one
turns.reply: The UrbanSling Ridge 34 L Travel Backpack costs ₹439 (MRP ₹505) and comes in maroon or black. It's waterproof, has a laptop compartment, several pockets and padded shoulder straps, and is rated 3.8 from 1,719 reviews.

cases.description: Comparing the first two shown. The two cheapest phones are a Zentrix and an Aurora.

turns.reply: The Zentrix costs the least, but for a little more the Aurora Neo gives you double the storage, a bigger battery and the highest rating of the three. None of these has 5G.

The Aurora Neo (₹7,229) beats the Zentrix Neo (₹7,099) on storage (128 vs 64 GB), battery (5237 vs 4223 mAh), camera (64 vs 12 MP), screen (6.3 vs 6.1 in) and rating (4.6 vs 4.0). Both have 4 GB RAM and no 5G, so the Zentrix only wins on price.

cases.description: No category or use case can be inferred.

turns.user: I need a gift for my sister.
turns.reply: Happy to help! What kind of gift are you thinking of, such as a watch, a kurta, a backpack or a kitchen appliance, and roughly what's your budget?

cases.description: A category the store doesn't carry.

turns.reply: Sorry, we don't sell televisions. We carry jackets, shoes, phones, laptops, backpacks, watches, kurtas and kitchen appliances. Can I help you find something in one of those?

cases.description: No gaming laptop is under ₹55,000; raising the budget by 15% (to ₹63,250) finds some.

turns.reply: No gaming laptops were in stock under ₹55,000, so I raised the budget to ₹63,250. The Vertex Air has the most RAM and is the lightest of the four, and the Quanta Pro is the only one with a high-tier CPU but has the lowest rating.

cases.description: An inferred extreme-warmth filter finds nothing under ₹2,000; dropping it (the user never said it) does.

turns.reply:
Warmth was inferred, so drop it.
I couldn't find any jacket rated for extreme cold under ₹2,000, so I removed that warmth filter. None of these will keep you warm at -20 degrees on their own; the warmest are the moderate-warmth Snowline fleece and Monsoonwear denim, which are best worn as layers.

cases.description: "Shaadi" maps to the wedding occasion and "5k tak" to a budget.

turns.user: Shaadi ke liye silk kurta chahiye, 5k tak
turns.reply: Men aur women dono ke silk kurtas hain, Kalakriti Noor sabse zyada rated hai aur DesiLoom Saanjh men ke liye accha option hai. Apna gender aur size bata dein to list aur chhoti kar deta hoon.

cases.description: "Teen hazaar tak" is a budget of ₹3,000, written in Hindi number words.

turns.user: Teen hazaar tak ki watch dikhao
turns.reply: Analog style chahiye toh Chronex Active sabse badhiya rated hai, aur digital mein Tempo Active top par hai. Aap batayein ki watch men, women ya unisex chahiye, toh options aur chhaant doon.

cases.description: "Aur sasta dikhao" is "cheaper", with the reply in Hinglish.

turns.reply: Swimming ke liye 100m water resistance wale Chronex Orbit ya Meridian Pulse lein. Kam budget mein Kaal Classic ki rating achhi hai.
Is range mein sirf ye 2 smartwatches hain, dono 100m water resistant. Meridian Classic mein metal strap hai aur Tempo Heritage mein silicone strap, jo workout ke liye zyada comfortable rehta hai.

cases.description: "Dusra wala" is the second one shown. The second-cheapest kurta is a Rangsutra.

turns.reply: Ye store ke sabse saste 3 kurte hain, pehle do women ke liye aur teesra men ke liye. Utsav wala sasta bhi hai aur sabse achhi rating wala bhi, lekin Taana ka kurta sirf S aur XXL size mein milta hai.

Rangsutra Heritage Rayon Kurta for Women (₹409) women ke liye short sleeves wala rayon kurta hai, jo daily wear ke liye bana hai. Ye M, L, XL size aur olive ya navy color mein milta hai. Iski rating 3.2 hai (999 reviews), jo baaki dono se kam hai. Agar rating aapke liye zaroori hai to Utsav wala kurta (₹399) sasta hai aur uski rating 5.0 hai.

cases.description: A vague Hinglish request gets one clarifying question in Hinglish.

turns.reply: Kya dhundh rahe hain aap, jaise jacket, shoes, phone, laptop, backpack, watch, kurta ya kitchen appliance?

cases.description: An out-of-scope Hinglish request is declined in Hinglish.

turns.user: Aaj Delhi ka mausam kaisa hai?
turns.reply: Maaf kijiye, main mausam ki jaankari nahi de sakta, main sirf shopping mein madad karta hoon. Agar thand hai to kya main aapke liye garam jacket ya kuch aur dhoondh doon?
